generator: xtb 6.7.1 (edcfbbe) --gfnff --grad, one thread, a fresh directory per run; slimmed from the full reference set

units.lattice: Bohr, rows are the lattice vectors
units.lattice_gradient: Hartree/Bohr, row i = dE/d(lattice vector i)
units.sigma: Hartree (dE/d strain, not divided by the volume)

conventions.sigma: sigma[a][b] = sum_i lattice_gradient[i][a] * lattice[i][b]; xtb's internal sigma = sum over interacting image positions r_a * dE/dr_b
conventions.positions: wrapped into the cell before writing; positions_bohr_xtb are the positions xtb printed (F20.14) after its own wrapping
